name: Ayumi Miyo
source:
The most level-headed member of the arts club. She's in charge of keeping the other members at bay.

She can't stand scary stories, and she often faints when hearing about horror or other occult stuff.

She's very serious, organized and reliable. She's respected by her teachers and she takes pride in it.

She's got among the top grades in the school, but she's on another level of terrible at anything physically demanding.

She's jealous of her sister who's good at both studying and physical activities.

"Shut up! I can't deal with this! Do it! Yourselves!"
